clips.title: The story
paras: The Yorgen Farmstead is a derelict farm nestled in southern Duskwood, fallen into ruin alongside the rest of the troubled region. Formerly owned by the farmer Sven Yorgen, the property has been seized and occupied by brigands of the Defias Brotherhood.

Situated amidst the gloomy woodlands of southern Duskwood, the Yorgen Farmstead was once a functioning homestead belonging to Sven Yorgen. Like many isolated holdings in the region, the farm could not withstand the encroaching perils of the territory. Sven was forced to abandon his lands, retreating north to a makeshift camp along the Darkened Bank. In his absence, the abandoned grounds were claimed by outlaws looking for a foothold far from the gaze of Stormwind's authorities.

Rather than lying vacant, the farmstead has been repurposed as a staging ground by the Defias Brotherhood. Masked highwaymen and stealthy cutthroats lurk among the decaying fences and weathered outbuildings, using the dense tree cover to conceal their presence. Travelers approaching the farmstead must tread carefully, as Defias assassins patrol the perimeter and ambush anyone trespassing on their newly seized sanctuary.
